title: Appropiate trademark usage

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Make the business relationship legible through placement and explanation, because a familiar mark can otherwise imply an unsupported association.
strategic_value: Clear prominence and explanatory text can preserve the meaning of IBM’s identity in external communications.
demonstration: The heading at left accompanies two explanatory paragraphs and a linked trademark list in the next column.
practical_value: Identify which relationship the mark must communicate before deciding its size and placement.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Set the printed Appropiate trademark usage heading in the left column.

content_islands.name: Relationship and ownership
content_islands.spec: Explain placement, prominence and text in the adjacent column, then define the trademark scope and link to the list.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says placement, prominence and explanatory text must make the business relationship clear.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page requires a clearly indicated IBM relationship and states IBM’s ownership of the trademarks.
